items.q: What kinds of engagements are you open to?
items.a: Full-time Staff or Senior Analyst, BI Lead, or analytics-led PM. Open to contract too: analytics audits, KPI design, BI builds, PRDs, 0→1 launches.

items.q: What types of products have you shipped?
items.a: B2B SaaS, IoT and telecom, AI platforms (MCP shipped on the GPT and Claude stores), data infrastructure, and nonprofit case management.

items.q: Do you lead analytics or product strategy?
items.a: Both. I write the SQL, build the dashboards, run the A/B tests, then turn what they say into PRDs, OKRs, and roadmap bets.

items.q: What does your typical process look like from idea to launch?
items.a: Objectives, then research, then the KPI framework, then the PRD, then ship, then watch the funnels and cohorts. The launch is the start of the work, not the end.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
